subject: Vendor registration & PO / AP onboarding for FinCo Payments
messages:
From: Linda Hayes <linda.hayes@fincopayments.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: ap@fincopayments.com
Date: 2025-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood

Hi Priyom,

Hope you’re well — FinCo is kicking off vendor registration for Redwood ahead of our pilot. Our AP team needs a completed onboarding packet so we can create you as a vendor in our system and issue purchase orders. High-level requirements: 

- Completed AP onboarding form (attached)
- W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) and VAT registration certificate if non-US entity
- Remit-to details and wiring instructions (we redact full account numbers in the vendor portal but need last 4 digits for verification)
- Confirm legal entity name and address exactly as you want it to appear on invoices
- Do you accept PO-numbered invoices only via our portal (Coupa) or via email to ap@fincopayments.com?
- Any special tax handling or exemptions we should be aware of

If you can return the completed onboarding form and W-9/VAT doc, we’ll create the vendor record and assign a vendor ID. We typically require PO number on the invoice for payment; please confirm how you’ll reference PO numbers on your invoices.

Attached: FinCo_AP_Onboarding_Form.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll aim to get you a vendor ID within 2–3 business days after we receive the packet.

Best,
Linda Hayes
Sr. Manager, Accounts Payable
FinCo Payments

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Linda Hayes <linda.hayes@fincopayments.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-20T11:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood

Linda — thanks for the note and the form. Looping in Marissa (finance) and Rishi (legal) so we can get the packet back to you fully filled. Quick answers up front:

- Vendor name: Redwood Inference Inc.
- Legal / remit address: 1212 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Tax ID: 12-3456789 (W-9 attached)
- We have a VAT certificate on file for our EU entity — attaching the certificate for your records
- Preferred invoice flow: we can do invoice upload into Coupa (preferred if you want PO matching) or email invoices to ap@fincopayments.com with PO in subject line. Either works — Marissa, which do you prefer for this account?

We will attach the W-9 and VAT cert now and return the FinCo onboarding form filled. For bank wiring details we generally share a masked document in our secure portal (last 4 digits, bank name, and routing will be on the AP packet). If you need the full account details to test deposit, we can provide them after vendor validation.

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_VAT_Certificate.pdf

Thanks — we’ll get the filled form back today.

—Priyom
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Linda Hayes <linda.hayes@fincopayments.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-21T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Completed AP packet and invoice/PO guidance

Hi Linda — thanks for sending the form. I’ve completed the FinCo onboarding spreadsheet and attached a filled copy (Redwood_AP_Packet_Filled.xlsx). A few clarifying points for your AP team to avoid processing delays: 

- Company name (as it should appear on the PO/invoice): Redwood Inference Inc.
- Remit-to: Redwood Inference Inc., 1212 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Tax ID: 12-3456789 (W-9 provided by Priyom)
- Banking: Bank of West — wiring instructions will be supplied in the packet; last 4 digits of account: 6789 (we are happy to confirm any test deposit info)
- Invoice requirements: please include FinCo PO number in the invoice header and file name. If you upload via Coupa, ensure the PO is attached to the invoice; if emailing to ap@fincopayments.com, please put the PO in the subject and PDF the invoice.
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 30; for the pilot we’re fine with Net 30 unless you require a different term — let us know if your vendor setup requires Net 45 or a special SLA.

Next steps for us: once you confirm vendor ID/PO acceptance flow, we’ll submit our first invoice referencing the PO and expected billing period. Attached: Redwood_AP_Packet_Filled.xlsx (contains masked banking, tax, and contact info).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance & Accounting
Redwood Inference

Before we finalize bank details in our system, could you confirm the last 4 digits of the Redwood deposit account (we have 6789 on file) and the billed entity name matches the one on your W-9?

Attachments: FinCo_PO_12345.pdf

Thanks,
Tom Barker

FinCo Payments
